Source: https://www.mystoredemo.io/
These are the original bytes of the publicly deployed MyStore Demo build, not an identified open-source application repository. No application-wide redistribution license was found. Dependency license notices are retained. Local controller adaptation and Chinese translations live outside this preserved source directory.
The public demo includes product list, product detail, cart, checkout, confirmation, error, and donation/collaborate routes. Adyen payment SDK calls are not a local payment backend and need a separate integration.
